{
  "query": "mutation ($input: EmployeeInput!) { addNewEmployee(input: $input) { success message employee { _id first_name employee_photo } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "first_name": "Photo",
      "last_name": "Test",
      "email": "photo.test2@test.com",
      "gender": "Male",
      "designation": "Developer",
      "salary": 5000,
      "date_of_joining": "2025-01-10",
      "department": "IT",
      "employee_photo_base64": "data:image/png;base64,"
    }
  }
}
